# Work Item Plan
## Work Item WI-001: 后端关卡列表 API 服务
### Identity
- schema_version: 1
- logical_work_item_id: WI-001
- title: 后端关卡列表 API 服务
- kind: backend
### Goal
- summary: WHEN 后端服务启动并接收 HTTP 请求 THE SYSTEM SHALL 以 Node 内置模块提供 GET /api/levels 关卡数据契约、静态页面托管与可注入可启停的服务生命周期。
### Non Goals
- non_goals: 不实现关卡玩法逻辑、用户认证与选中关卡后的行为。
- non_goals: 不引入数据库、外部服务或任何 npm 依赖。
- non_goals: 不编写 web/** 页面与 tests/frontend/**、tests/integration/** 测试。
### Dependencies
- depends_on: []
### Inputs
### Outputs
- contract_id: CT-001
- capabilities: GET /api/levels
- capabilities: success 200 top-level array of exactly 5 items
- capabilities: item fields id name difficulty unlocked
- capabilities: field constraints for id name difficulty unlocked
- capabilities: error envelope error.code and error.message
- capabilities: unknown API path 404
- capabilities: unsupported method 405
- capabilities: success Content-Type application/json; charset=utf-8
- capabilities: API error Content-Type application/json; charset=utf-8
- capabilities: data failure 500 LEVEL_DATA_UNAVAILABLE
- contract_id: CT-002
- capabilities: createServer(options) factory
- capabilities: injectable dataPath default data/levels.json
- capabilities: injectable staticRoot default web/
- capabilities: start({port}) returns Promise resolving {origin port stop}
- capabilities: port 0 yields ephemeral port
- capabilities: stop() releases the listener
- capabilities: GET /api/levels returns 200 array of exactly 5 items over HTTP
- capabilities: data failure returns 500 LEVEL_DATA_UNAVAILABLE over HTTP
- capabilities: API error Content-Type application/json; charset=utf-8
### Tasks
- task_id: TASK-001
- statement: WHEN 服务读取 dataPath 指向的关卡数据文件 THE SYSTEM SHALL 解析 JSON 并校验记录恰为五项、id 为非空字符串且文件内唯一、name 为非空字符串、difficulty 取值属于简单、普通、困难，unlocked 为布尔值。
- requirement_refs: REQ-003
- done_when_refs: AC-001
- done_when_refs: AC-002
- task_id: TASK-002
- statement: WHEN 服务实现请求路由 THE SYSTEM SHALL 将 GET /api/levels 映射为成功返回五项顶层数组，并将数据错误、未知 API 路径与不支持方法分别映射为 500、404、405 的 JSON 错误响应。
- requirement_refs: REQ-002
- done_when_refs: AC-001
- done_when_refs: AC-002
- done_when_refs: AC-003
- task_id: TASK-003
- statement: WHEN 服务模块实现生命周期 THE SYSTEM SHALL 导出 createServer(options) 工厂与 start({port})，并在 port 为 0 时返回含 origin、实际端口与 stop 的句柄且 stop 调用后释放监听。
- requirement_refs: REQ-004
- done_when_refs: AC-004
- task_id: TASK-004
- statement: WHEN 服务实现静态托管 THE SYSTEM SHALL 以 staticRoot 为根用 node:path 规范化请求路径并拒绝越界访问，对根内资源返回正确 Content-Type，对缺失资源返回 404 文本响应。
- requirement_refs: REQ-004
- done_when_refs: AC-005
- task_id: TASK-005
- statement: WHEN 编写后端测试 THE SYSTEM SHALL 仅以 node --test 在 tests/backend 运行并用 tests/backend/fixtures 自有夹具覆盖成功响应、数据缺失、JSON 解析失败、结构校验失败、404 与 405、静态托管路径安全及生命周期启停，且不读取 web/**。
- requirement_refs: REQ-002
- requirement_refs: REQ-003
- requirement_refs: REQ-004
- requirement_refs: NFR-001
- done_when_refs: AC-001
- done_when_refs: AC-002
- done_when_refs: AC-003
- done_when_refs: AC-004
- done_when_refs: AC-005
### Write Policy
- exclusive_scopes: server/**
- exclusive_scopes: data/levels.json
- exclusive_scopes: tests/backend/**
- forbidden_scopes: web/**
- forbidden_scopes: tests/frontend/**
- forbidden_scopes: tests/integration/**
- forbidden_scopes: package.json
### Acceptance Criteria
- criterion_id: AC-001
- statement: WHEN 对运行中的服务发起 GET /api/levels 且数据有效 THE SYSTEM SHALL 返回 200 与 Content-Type 为 application/json; charset=utf-8 的顶层数组，且恰含五项字段完整且合法的记录。
- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution
- criterion_id: AC-002
- statement: WHEN 关卡数据文件缺失、不可解析或字段结构不合法 THE SYSTEM SHALL 返回 500 与含 code 为 LEVEL_DATA_UNAVAILABLE 的错误信封。
- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution
- criterion_id: AC-003
- statement: WHEN 请求未知 API 路径或对 /api/levels 使用不支持的 HTTP 方法 THE SYSTEM SHALL 分别返回 404 与 405 的 JSON 错误响应。
- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution
- criterion_id: AC-004
- statement: WHEN 以 createServer 与 start({port:0}) 启动服务 THE SYSTEM SHALL 返回含 origin、实际端口与 stop 的句柄且 stop 调用后释放端口。
- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution
- criterion_id: AC-005
- statement: WHEN 请求静态根内资源、越界路径或缺失资源 THE SYSTEM SHALL 分别返回正确 Content-Type 的文件内容、拒绝越界访问与 404 文本响应。
- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution
### Verification
- check_id: CHECK-001
- command: node --test tests/backend
- manual_instruction: null
- required: true
- non_zero_test_execution_required: true
### Handoff Schema
- required_fields: api_path
- required_fields: default_port
- required_fields: port_env
- provided_contract_refs: CT-001
- provided_contract_refs: CT-002
- reviewer_check_refs: AC-001
- reviewer_check_refs: AC-002
- reviewer_check_refs: AC-003
- reviewer_check_refs: AC-004
- reviewer_check_refs: AC-005
### Blockers
### Traceability

- source_id: story_spec_0001
- requirement_id: REQ-002
- source_type: story_spec
- source_id: story_spec_0001
- requirement_id: REQ-003
- source_type: story_spec
- source_id: story_spec_0001
- requirement_id: REQ-004
- source_type: story_spec
- source_id: story_spec_0001
- requirement_id: NFR-001
## Work Item WI-002: 关卡选择页前端
### Identity
- schema_version: 1
- logical_work_item_id: WI-002
- title: 关卡选择页前端
- kind: frontend
### Goal
- summary: WHEN 玩家打开关卡选择页 THE SYSTEM SHALL 调用 GET /api/levels 校验响应并渲染关卡名称、难度与锁定状态，在请求失败或响应非法时展示可读错误且不白屏。
### Non Goals
- non_goals: 不实现关卡玩法逻辑与选中关卡后的行为。
- non_goals: 不引入前端框架、构建工具或任何 npm 依赖。
- non_goals: 不启动浏览器且不引入浏览器自动化。
- non_goals: 不修改 server/**、data/levels.json 与 tests/backend/**、tests/integration/**。
### Dependencies
- depends_on: WI-001
### Inputs
- contract_id: CT-001
- provider_logical_work_item_id: WI-001
- required_capabilities: GET /api/levels
- required_capabilities: success 200 top-level array of exactly 5 items
- required_capabilities: item fields id name difficulty unlocked
- required_capabilities: field constraints for id name difficulty unlocked
- required_capabilities: error envelope error.code and error.message
- required_capabilities: data failure 500 LEVEL_DATA_UNAVAILABLE
- compatibility_policy: require_all
### Outputs
- contract_id: CT-003
- capabilities: page entry web/index.html
- capabilities: container ids loading level-list error-message
- capabilities: script web/level-select.js
- capabilities: script references /api/levels by relative path
- capabilities: initLevelSelect({document, fetchImpl}) injectable interface
- capabilities: renders name and difficulty per item
- capabilities: unlocked false renders locked and non-selectable
- capabilities: failure renders readable error without blank page
### Tasks
- task_id: TASK-006
- statement: WHEN 构建关卡选择页骨架 THE SYSTEM SHALL 在 web/index.html 提供 id 为 loading、level-list、error-message 的三个容器标记并引用 web/level-select.js。
- requirement_refs: REQ-005
- done_when_refs: AC-006
- task_id: TASK-007
- statement: WHEN 页面脚本实现数据消费 THE SYSTEM SHALL 导出 initLevelSelect({document, fetchImpl}) 接口并以相对路径调用 GET /api/levels，在校验响应为五项且字段合法后渲染名称与难度，并将 unlocked 为 false 的项渲染为锁定不可选。
- requirement_refs: REQ-005
- done_when_refs: AC-007
- done_when_refs: AC-008
- task_id: TASK-008
- statement: WHEN 页面脚本实现异常分支 THE SYSTEM SHALL 在请求失败、非成功状态或响应结构非法时于错误容器展示可读提示并保留页面框架不白屏。
- requirement_refs: REQ-006
- done_when_refs: AC-009
- task_id: TASK-009
- statement: WHEN 编写前端测试 THE SYSTEM SHALL 仅以 node --test 在 tests/frontend 运行，通过注入 document 与 fetchImpl 替身验证渲染、锁定态与错误分支，且不启动浏览器。
- requirement_refs: REQ-005
- requirement_refs: REQ-006
- requirement_refs: NFR-001
- done_when_refs: AC-008
- done_when_refs: AC-009
### Write Policy
- exclusive_scopes: web/**
- exclusive_scopes: tests/frontend/**
- forbidden_scopes: server/**
- forbidden_scopes: data/levels.json
- forbidden_scopes: tests/backend/**
- forbidden_scopes: tests/integration/**
- forbidden_scopes: package.json
### Acceptance Criteria
- criterion_id: AC-006
- statement: WHEN 查看 web/index.html 源文件 THE SYSTEM SHALL 包含 id 为 loading、level-list、error-message 的容器标记与 web/level-select.js 的脚本引用。
- required_evidence: source_diff
- criterion_id: AC-007
- statement: WHEN 查看 web/level-select.js 源文件 THE SYSTEM SHALL 暴露 initLevelSelect({document, fetchImpl}) 接口并以相对路径引用 /api/levels。
- required_evidence: source_diff
- criterion_id: AC-008
- statement: WHEN 注入的 fetchImpl 返回合法五项数据 THE SYSTEM SHALL 在列表容器渲染每项名称与难度，且 unlocked 为 false 的项呈锁定不可选状态。
- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution
- criterion_id: AC-009
- statement: WHEN 注入的 fetchImpl 失败、返回非成功状态或响应结构非法 THE SYSTEM SHALL 进入错误提示分支并保留页面框架不白屏。
- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution
### Verification
- check_id: CHECK-002
- command: node --test tests/frontend
- manual_instruction: null
- required: true
- non_zero_test_execution_required: true
### Handoff Schema
- required_fields: page_entry_path
- required_fields: container_ids
- required_fields: script_path
- required_fields: init_level_select_interface
- provided_contract_refs: []
- reviewer_check_refs: AC-006
- reviewer_check_refs: AC-007
- reviewer_check_refs: AC-008
- reviewer_check_refs: AC-009

### Traceability

- source_id: story_spec_0001
- requirement_id: REQ-005
- source_type: story_spec
- source_id: story_spec_0001
- requirement_id: REQ-006

- source_id: story_spec_0001

## Work Item WI-003: 前后端集成验证
### Identity
- schema_version: 1
- logical_work_item_id: WI-003
- title: 前后端集成验证
- kind: integration
### Goal
- summary: WHEN 前后端产物就绪 THE SYSTEM SHALL 在同一 HTTP origin 上以 node --test 验证页面入口、关卡 API 的可观测契约与错误分支证据，且不修改实现。
### Non Goals
- non_goals: 不修改 server/**、web/**、data/levels.json 与 tests/backend/**、tests/frontend/** 既有内容。
- non_goals: 不引入浏览器自动化或任何 npm 依赖。
- non_goals: 不断言页面动态渲染后的可视结果，该断言归属前端工作项。
### Dependencies
- depends_on: WI-001
- depends_on: WI-002
### Inputs

- provider_logical_work_item_id: WI-001
- required_capabilities: createServer(options) factory
- required_capabilities: injectable dataPath default data/levels.json
- required_capabilities: injectable staticRoot default web/
- required_capabilities: start({port}) returns Promise resolving {origin port stop}
- required_capabilities: port 0 yields ephemeral port
- required_capabilities: stop() releases the listener
- required_capabilities: GET /api/levels returns 200 array of exactly 5 items over HTTP
- required_capabilities: data failure returns 500 LEVEL_DATA_UNAVAILABLE over HTTP
- required_capabilities: API error Content-Type application/json; charset=utf-8
- compatibility_policy: require_all
### Outputs

- capabilities: error branch evidence via injectable dataPath without touching production data
### Tasks

- statement: WHEN 编写集成测试 THE SYSTEM SHALL 以 createServer 与 start({port:0}) 启动服务并对返回 origin 发起 GET / 与 GET /api/levels，结束后调用 stop 释放端口。

- requirement_refs: REQ-005
- done_when_refs: AC-011
- task_id: TASK-012
- statement: WHEN 集成测试以 dataPath 指向不存在的数据路径启动独立实例 THE SYSTEM SHALL 断言 GET /api/levels 返回 500、含 LEVEL_DATA_UNAVAILABLE 的错误信封与 Content-Type application/json; charset=utf-8，且不修改 data/levels.json。

- requirement_refs: NFR-001
- done_when_refs: AC-012

- forbidden_scopes: tests/backend/**

- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution
- criterion_id: AC-011

- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution
